visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace the Recursion with a Loop
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The recursion does nothing a loop cannot, and every call uses stack space. Rewrite the reversal with a while loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: This recursion adds one stack frame per two characters and gains nothing over a loop. The loop uses constant memory, and the function no longer asks the caller to pass the indexes.
